examples.arabic: عمو حسني، موظف متقاعد، وجد كوب شاي أخضر أمامه.
examples.english: Uncle Hosni, a retired employee, found a cup of green tea in front of him.
examples.transliteration: 'Ammu Hosni, muwazzaf mutaqa'id, wagad kobb shay akhdar amamah.

examples.arabic: الموظف كان لطيف جدا وقبل يرجع الكتاب بسهولة
examples.english: The employee was very kind and accepted to return the book easily.
examples.transliteration: El-moẓẓaf kān laṭīf geddan w-ʾabel yeraggaʿ el-ketāb be-sohūla.
